import copy
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, 'src')

before = copy.deepcopy(rows)

assert list_active(rows, 1, 2) == [rows[5]]

assert list_active(rows, 0, 2)[1] is rows[3]

    try:
        list_active(rows, page, size)
    except ValueError:
        pass
    else:
        raise AssertionError((page,size))

'@ | python -B -
